Oncall Bot: [ALERT] High GPU queue growth detected in gpool-prod-2 (eu-west-1) — backlog 220 reqs, pool util 95%. Autoscaler reporting failed launches and driver pods crashing. Paging @Eli @Maria @Jana :rotating_light:
Eli: I'm on it. seeing repeated CUDA/Xid 59 and OOM traces on driver pods, nodes flapping.
Maria: Confirmed — kernel logs showing GPU reset then kubelet marking node NotReady.
Jana: Autoscaler shows scale attempts but cloud API returns 'quota/exhausted' and instance launches failing; also saw taint removal errors during node join.
Eli: Paste from driver pod log snapshot:
```
[2026-06-05T08:12:03Z] nvml: Xid 59: GPU has fallen off the bus
[2026-06-05T08:12:04Z] kubelet: container runtime restarting driver-daemon
[2026-06-05T08:12:05Z] driver: oom-kill process nvidia-driver (pid=4123)
```
Ops Lead: Autoscaler couldn't scale because regional spare quota is 0/4 GPUs available; earlier manual rampdown removed buffer. Also cloud API transient 429s during launch window.
Priya: Customer impact — Hosted API 503 rate increased, tail latency >8s. Pulling top affected customers now.
Customer Success Bot: Notifying customers with active Dedicated contracts in eu-west-1 (CS-101, CS-214) :email:
Eli: Immediate mitigation plan (live):
- Step 1: Disable autoscaler auto-ramp to stop repeated failed launches (Ops Lead)
- Step 2: Manually provision 2 ephemeral GPU nodes in gpool-ephemeral to relieve backlog (SRE)
- Step 3: Roll driver daemonset to pinned older driver image (known-stable) to stop OOM/Xid cycle (Infra)
- Step 4: Route low-priority/large-ctx jobs to CPU-fallback and enable aggressive caching for embeddings (DevEx/Product)
- Step 5: CS to notify impacted customers and set expectations; full postmortem after stabilization
Maria: Performing driver rollback: `kubectl set image daemonset/driver nvidia-driver=redwood/driver:v2026-03-stable` -> rollout started.
Jana: Launched 2 nodes (g4dn.eqv) manually into gpool-ephemeral; autoscaler disabled. Attaching to cluster, kubelet ready.
Eli: After rollback, OOM/Xid frequency dropped to near zero on updated nodes. One remaining node reported a transient Xid 79 then stabilized.
Priya: Draft CS message: "We are aware of GPU capacity incidents in eu-west-1 causing increased latency and some 503s; mitigations are in progress; we will provide an update within 30 minutes." Approving to send.
Ops Lead: Also applied temporary model-routing rule to map large-ctx models -> quantized variants to reduce per-request memory pressure (policy ID: route-qr-2026-06).
SRE-Robot: Metrics: queue depth 220 -> 38 over 12 minutes after manual nodes joined and rollback. No new node flaps in last 6 minutes.
Customer Success Bot: Notifications delivered; CS-101 acknowledged :thumbsup:.
Eli: Follow-ups / next actions:
- Keep autoscaler disabled until driver image validated across all AZs
- Soak test 2 hours on gpool-ephemeral with real traffic profile
- Schedule postmortem including driver/kernel team, autoscaler engineers, SRE, and infra (owners assigned)
Jana: Handing off monitoring to night oncall @Priya, stepping off. Summary pinned to channel.
Priya: Taking incident. I'll watch for any recurring Xid/OOM and will re-enable autoscaler only after a successful soak and kernel stability confirmed.
Oncall Bot: Incident state updated: mitigated; severity=medium; handoff -> Priya."
